UPDATE "orderExecutions" 
SET "CancelNote" = 'Critical Leverage'
WHERE "Ord_Link" IN (
    SELECT o."ORD_STAMP"
    FROM orders o
    JOIN riskandmargin r ON o."ORD_STAMP" = r."ordStamp"
    JOIN marketdata md ON o."exchSpot" = md."EXCH_SPOT"
    JOIN marketstats ms ON md."EXCH_SPOT" = ms."md_link"
    WHERE NULLIF(REPLACE(ms."priceShiftDay", '%', ''), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND (r.margin_risk_profile->>'leverage')::numeric * NULLIF(REPLACE(ms."priceShiftDay", '%', ''), '')::numeric > 500
);
